menu.label: Principles of Health and Public Health

hero.title: Stopping the CoronaVirus Pandemic
hero.subtitle: Since the first confirmed case of a new, virulent strain of the coronavirus in December of 2019 in Wuhan, China, the disease has spread worldwide. As of April 6, 2021, there are 130,459,184 confirmed cases and 2,842,325 deaths. These numbers are still increasing.
